primary_metric: Flickr30k Karpathy validation mean bidirectional R@1

hypotheses.statement: At least one LoRA arm improves the three-seed validation mean over M_T1 by more than one pooled SD while remaining below 5M trainable inference parameters and the 9.480 ms Q3 latency ceiling.
Vision-only and text-only arms will identify whether the remaining recoverable deficit is concentrated in one frozen tower; no directional winner is predicted.
No prior is assigned to exceeding the locally measured OpenCLIP Flickr-validation mean R@1 of 69.94082840236686%.

promotion_rule: Among latency- and parameter-eligible arms, promote the highest validation mean only if its gain over M_T1 exceeds one pooled SD. This is a practical heuristic, not a significance test.
hard_stop: No rank, layer-count, alpha, dropout, LR or target-module tuning is permitted after results are observed.
